ID: `jado-frontend`.

## What it does

Applies the assigned activities: jado-design-systems, jado-ui-builder, jado-ui-engineer and jado-motion. Preserves stack, direction and scope; phases on the same artifact are sequential.

## When to use it

When the principal or an already active agent needs to apply one or more domain procedures in the same context.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-frontend` in Claude Code or `$jado-frontend` in Codex. Provide the contract, assigned activities, order, scope and required evidence. Use role procedures without starting other agents.

## What it delivers

- Assigned outcomes with revision, evidence and limitations

## Example

Apply jado-frontend in the current context, limited to the assigned activities.

## Prerequisites

- Readable JADO root and tools required by the assigned procedures.
